items.guidance: Pass NPM_TOKEN only as a build-time secret or build argument consumed by the existing .npmrc (if present) during npm ci, and keep it out of the final image layers, e.g. via a multi-stage build. Since tsc emits dist/, compile in a builder stage, then copy dist/ plus production-only node_modules into the runtime stage. Default PORT to 3000 for EXPOSE, and read STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and DATABASE_URL only at runtime.

Search the code that uses pg for startup schema logic, such as CREATE TABLE statements or a migrations folder of .sql files, in the web and worker entry sources that compile to dist/web.js and dist/worker.js. Report the file path if one exists, or report that none exists.
